# ADR-3277: AWS tagging_compute: Prefer Graviton or right-sized instance families for service 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Oversized fleets waste spend and expand patch surface.

## Decision

Platforms SHOULD prefer Graviton or right-sized instance families for service 5 (AWS-tagging_compute-5) when optimizing cost without weakening isolation.

## Consequences

Rightsizing reviews run monthly.
